leadText: Kevin Kolack is an American voice actor for the English dub of The Legend of Thunder!.
plainText:
Kevin Kolack is an American voice actor for the English dub of The Legend of Thunder!.

==Biography==
Kolack was born on October 25, 1969, in Austin, Texas. He became a voice actor as an adult and was primarily affiliated with 4Kids Entertainment until sometime before they filed for bankruptcy. He also acted on live-action productions. Kolack voiced Vincent in the special The Legend of Thunder!, which aired internationally as the first three episodes of Pokémon Chronicles.
